title: The Verification Labor Thesis
topic: jobs that shrink, jobs that become high-demand and underpriced, and how to educate people accordingly in the Codex/agentic-AI era

duplicate_or_canceled_agents.reason: compaction hid the original agent id, so a duplicate was spawned and then shut down after the original result surfaced

one_sentence_thesis: Agentic AI kills the cheap junior task ladder faster than it kills work itself, while labor scarcity migrates to people who can verify, evidence, govern, insure, integrate, and certify AI-mediated work.

promoted_calls.name: The Entry Ladder Breaks
promoted_calls.forecast: By 2030, the entry ladder in AI-exposed white-collar work is visibly broken: 22-25 employment in at least four named software/support/analyst occupation groups is 20% below pre-ChatGPT trend, while AI evaluation/assurance postings outnumber entry-level software QA postings.
jobs_that_shrink: tier-one help desk and SaaS support
junior market research or BI analyst
junior operations or finance analyst doing templated reports
high_demand_underpriced_roles: AI procurement and vendor risk analyst
promoted_calls.key_metric: 22-25 employment index plus AI assurance to entry-level software QA posting ratio
promoted_calls.kill_risk: Junior employment recovers to trend and AI-evaluation postings remain a niche category.

promoted_calls.name: Evidence-Pack Engineers Beat Junior Builders
promoted_calls.forecast: By 2029, federal AI buying makes evidence-pack engineers scarcer than junior builders.
jobs_that_shrink: generic AI PM without governance artifacts
promoted_calls.key_metric: share of federal AI solicitations requiring testing, documentation, monitoring, impact assessment, QASP, or vendor evidence
promoted_calls.kill_risk: Federal procurement accepts lightweight vendor claims without process evidence.

promoted_calls.name: AI Audit Trails Become Insurance Passports
promoted_calls.forecast: By 2030, AI audit trails become an underwriting passport for cyber and commercial liability risk transfer.
jobs_that_shrink: checklist GRC analyst without runtime evidence
one-off ethics reviewer detached from logs and claims evidence
model evaluator who stops at benchmark scores
portfolio_artifacts: AI system inventory and criticality map
AI event-log schema and data dictionary
model, dataset, tool, and vendor provenance register
AI tabletop exercise and after-action report
promoted_calls.key_metric: number of underwriting questionnaires, policies, or regulator protocols asking for AI inventory, logs, governance, model evidence, or incident reconstruction
promoted_calls.kill_risk: Insurers price AI risk without differentiated evidence requirements.

promoted_calls.name: Verifier Curriculum Beats Prompt Engineering
promoted_calls.forecast: By 2030, AI programs with at least 25% AI-output verification, rubric design, test-case design, review protocol, and learning-scaffold design beat generic prompt-engineering or junior-coding bootcamps by placement or wage.
jobs_that_shrink: junior coding bootcamp graduate trained mainly to produce CRUD apps
AI content operator who only generates drafts
manual QA tester who only follows scripts
bootcamp TA or grader who only explains syntax
promoted_calls.key_metric: 180-day relevant placement rate and first-year wage compared with prompt-engineering or junior-coding bootcamp comparators
promoted_calls.kill_risk: Automated eval tooling commoditizes human verification before a durable role forms.

promoted_calls.name: Workflow Owners Replace Routine Coordinators
promoted_calls.forecast: By 2030, routine coordinator title demand falls at least 25% in postings share while AI workflow/integration owners become the overlooked middle-skill premium.
jobs_that_shrink: project coordinator focused on status updates
promoted_calls.key_metric: routine coordinator postings share index, AI workflow operations postings index, and wage premium vs matched coordinator postings
promoted_calls.kill_risk: AI workflow postings remain concentrated in software-engineering titles rather than middle-skill operations roles.

promoted_calls.name: Teachers Become Validators of Judgment
promoted_calls.forecast: By 2032, credential-bearing education shifts scarce human labor from generic instruction to accountable validation.
promoted_calls.education_product: Accountable Validation and Performance Assessment Certificate
promoted_calls.key_metric: growth in required validation events, examiner/assessor postings, and employer-rated credibility of process portfolios
promoted_calls.kill_risk: Credential bodies validate AI-era learning mostly through automated oral exams, proctoring, or detectors without human validation roles.

promoted_calls.name: Education Moves From Output Trust to Process Evidence
promoted_calls.forecast: By 2032, AI-exposed assessment shifts from final-output trust to required process evidence across higher ed, K-12 entities, and education-sector integrity/governance jobs.
high_demand_underpriced_roles: AI-use disclosure and process forensics lead
promoted_calls.education_product: Process Evidence and AI Assessment Integrity Certificate
promoted_calls.key_metric: number of institutions requiring process evidence, oral defense, supervised performance, or AI-use disclosure in AI-exposed assessment
promoted_calls.kill_risk: Institutions accept final-output ambiguity or rely on detectors/proctoring without process evidence.

promoted_calls.name: K-12 Demand Moves to Compliance Navigation
promoted_calls.forecast: By 2030, K-12 labor demand shifts from generic homework/content help to IEP, assistive-tech, evaluation, Medicaid, and compliance navigators.
high_demand_underpriced_roles: school-based Medicaid documentation and claiming navigator
promoted_calls.key_metric: special-ed navigator postings, evaluation backlogs, service-minute compliance, AT implementation, Medicaid denials, and family satisfaction
promoted_calls.kill_risk: Funding or reimbursement constraints suppress navigator hiring despite caseload demand.
